svg.title: TetraGate node - board layout
svg.text: 7Semi Anchor STM32G030F6P6 + RFM95W - illustration, not to scale
One node per channel. The identity and frequency are compile-time constants in Core/Inc/node_config.h, so each board gets its own build.
No sensor is fitted: node_packet.c synthesises a plausible reading from the MCU's unique ID, which is what makes four identical boards look different.
